# Lab 10.3: Lakehouse (formerly BigLake) Tables

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Lakehouse table that reads files through a connection, so users need no bucket access, then turn on metadata caching and add row-level security.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Let the connection read the bucket.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SA=$(bq show --format=json --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_conn | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['cloudResource']['serviceAccountId'])")
gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs \
  --member=serviceAccount:$SA --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create the Lakehouse table with metadata caching.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT` and `YOUR_BUCKET`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE lab10.names_lake
WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*'],
  max_staleness = INTERVAL 1 HOUR,
  metadata_cache_mode = 'AUTOMATIC'
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Add row-level security on the files.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY only_ca
ON lab10.names_lake
GRANT TO ('user:YOUR_EMAIL')
FILTER USING (state = 'CA');

SELECT DISTINCT state FROM lab10.names_lake;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You now see only `CA`. Plain external tables cannot do this.

4. **[CLI] Refresh the metadata cache manually.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "CALL BQ.REFRESH_EXTERNAL_METADATA_CACHE('lab10.names_lake')"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Compare with the plain external table.** Open `names_lake → Details`. It shows the **connection**, **max staleness** and **metadata cache mode**. Users can query it with only BigQuery permissions; they need no rights on the bucket.

6. **[SQL] Remove the policy.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DROP ALL ROW ACCESS POLICIES ON lab10.names_lake;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Access delegation | Connection reads files, users don't need bucket access |
| Metadata cache | Faster planning, refreshed automatically |
| Fine-grained security | Row and column policies on files |
| Name | BigLake is now Lakehouse; commands still say `biglake` |
